## The gap: timely, rigorous, and collaborative evidence

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="45%"}
- Chris Whitty, then Chief Scientific Adviser and later Chief Medical
  Officer for England, set out what modelling evidence has to be to
  inform policy effectively
- It has to be timely, rigorous, and collaborative
- Most of what we build manages two of the three

::: {.attribution}
Whitty (2015),
[doi:10.1186/s12916-015-0544-8](https://doi.org/10.1186/s12916-015-0544-8)
:::
